kind: read-only + direct-nix-build; NOT the full pre-registered run
units: sizes in MB (1 MB = 1e6 bytes), uncompressed

control_plane_memory.note: management set = hop3-server master + 1 worker; measured with 1 app deployed

closure_vs_image.note: Nix = narSize sum of runtime closure (uncompressed); Docker = docker image inspect .Size of the matching upstream tag (uncompressed); update_delta_mb = the app's own store-path (bytes re-sent on a source-only bump, pinned deps unchanged). Ordered by closure size.

dedup.note: deduplicated union closure vs sum of individual closures — depends on runtime homogeneity

deploy_timing.note: 2026-07-20 run on a FRESH throwaway Hetzner cpx41 (8 vCPU/16GB x86_64, then deleted). cold_install = blank server -> OS deps + all toolchains + Hop3 + first app running & HTTP-verified. per_app = a full hop3-test cycle on the already-installed box (cached toolchain re-provision check + build + deploy + HTTP verify + teardown), so it is an upper bound on app-deploy cost, not a bare deploy.
deploy_timing.note_g4: apps are torn down after each hop3-test cycle, so a memory-vs-app-count CURVE (G4) still needs a persistent-deploy pass; this run gives the 0-app baseline only.

control_plane_baselines.note: 2026-07-20; three cpx41 boxes (8 vCPU/16GB x86_64) — K3s + Compose fresh & deleted, Hop3 measured on the dev box. Metric = systemd-service cgroup memory.current (bytes; charges page cache, so soft absolutes but consistent across stacks); free-m system RAM given alongside. K3s installed lean (traefik/servicelb/metrics-server disabled).
control_plane_baselines.hop3_vs_k3s: like-for-like (same metric, same workload): 7.8x lighter with 1 workload (185 vs 1441 MB cgroup); 6.4x vs idle K3s (185 vs 1183). NO ratio is computed against K3s's 916 MB free-m whole-system figure — that is a different scope and no matching Hop3 whole-system measurement was taken.
control_plane_baselines.caveat_metric_direction: cgroup memory.current does NOT uniformly overstate the resident set: Hop3's 185 MB cgroup (server+rootd) is BELOW its 204.6 MB PSS / 258.1 MB RSS (those cover only the two ASGI processes). Scopes differ; do not mix.
control_plane_baselines.caveat_hop3_host: Hop3 was measured on the long-lived dev host, K3s/Compose on fresh cpx41 boxes — not three identical boxes. A fresh-box Hop3 re-measure would remove this asymmetry (bias currently runs against Hop3).
